Cards work on **hosted checkout** (fastest) or **embedded** flows with [Payment Elements](/build/payments/lomi-payment-elements) and `POST /charge/card`.

<DocsScreenshot name="build/cards" alt="Card payment form on lomi. hosted checkout" />

## Hosted checkout (recommended)

1. Create a checkout session.
2. Customer selects **Card** and enters details on lomi.. page.
3. Handle 3D Secure when the test card or issuer requires authentication.
4. Verify with webhooks before fulfilling.

## Embedded card charge

1. `POST /charge/card` → receive `client_secret`.
2. Confirm with Payment Elements on your site.
3. Poll or webhook for final `transaction_status`.

See [Cards guide](/build/cards), [Charges API](/api/charge/ChargesController_createCardCharge), and the [direct charge reference app](/build/direct-charges#reference-implementation).

## Sandbox test cards

| PAN | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `4242 4242 4242 4242` | Success |
| Decline / auth test numbers | See [Sandbox payments](/start/sandbox-payments#testing-card-payments) |

<Callout type="warn">
  Never use real card numbers in test mode or test numbers in live mode.
</Callout>
